notes.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious! Day -- A MASSIVE Announcement Buffet!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35579056/95a8ca883129177f9e122898489af0fe31875849.png[/img]

[h1]It's Cook, Serve, Delicious! Day![/h1]
I'm absolutely ecstatic this day has arrived as we've revealed several new developments for [i]Cook, Serve, Delicious![/i] including an all-new remaster of the original CSD!
 
First, if you haven't heard: We have a brand new patch out for [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1000030/Cook_Serve_Delicious_3/]Cook, Serve, Delicious! 3?![/url][/i] that officially makes the game Steam Deck Verified! Included in the update: Adjustments to the font size and clarity for the food descriptions and stats, added some minor improvements to gameplay related code, and brought the game up to the latest Game Maker engine build -- which should improve performance for some users! As always you can roll back to the last update should you need to. Full patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1000030/view/3667665767287602561?l=english]here[/url]!

[h2]What else, you say? So much more![/h2]
[i]Cook, Serve, Delicious: Re-Mustard![/i] is coming to PC and consoles in 2024! You can read more about the new features on the Steam page (be sure to wishlist it!!) but we plan on adding new modes, new features, more foods, a new campaign, while still retaining the same classic gameplay as the first game. For those who want to shake things up a bit, we also plan on adding an all new Typing mode that tests your Ingredients-Per-Minute! Look forward to more details in the months to come!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2139040/Cook_Serve_Delicious_ReMustard/
 
For the first time ever, the OG [i]Cook, Serve, Delicious![/i] is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/247020/view/3649655808281600357]coming to Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5 and Xbox![/url] It always felt odd to have CSD 2 and 3 on consoles but not the original, and this is a great way to enjoy a classic before the all new remake comes out next year. Be sure to grab it on your platform of choice when it arrives on consoles later this year!
 
A [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1928090/view/3645152208656446447]new Early Access update[/url] will release in August for [i]Cook Serve Forever[/i]! This update will have all new locations, more story, new achievements, new side quests, new foods, and lots more! We've been working hard over the last few months on the gameplay side of things and making the game run smoother and faster, and this is our first major content drop since launch.

For those looking to stay current with all of our updates and reveals, check out Vertigo's [url=https://vginc.substack.com/]newsletter[/url] and the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/cookservedelicious]CSD Discord[/url]. Thanks so much for all the support!

notes.title: CSD 3 is now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/15c4a80c58481929f03272bf355b92a74082000c.png[/img]

Hey everyone! I dunno about y'all but I absolutely love my Steam Deck, and I'm super excited to announce that we have a brand new patch that officially makes the game Steam Deck Verified! Woo!

We went back and adjusted the font size and clarity for the food descriptions and stats, as well as added some minor improvements to gameplay related code and brought the game up to the latest Game Maker engine build, which should improve performance for some users! As always you can roll back to the last update should you need to. 

Thanks everyone and the details are below- and two more things to announce: late July we're going to have some mouthwatering, absolutely [b]Delicious[/b] announcements. These are gonna be [b]big ones[/b] and you're not gonna want to miss it- be sure to join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discordapp.com/invite/cookservedelicious]Discord[/url] or sub to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://vginc.substack.com/]Newsletter[/url] for up to the minute news on the future of CSD!

Secondly we just released our spinoff game, Cook Serve Forever, into early access! If you're looking for a more relaxed, chill game that is a very different type of vibe than the CSD series, check it out! (And it also plays great on the Deck as well!) And did you know if you've bought all three of our games you can get Cook Serve Forever at a nice discount? Check out the Cook Serve Series bundle today!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32041/The_Cook_Serve_Series_Bundle/

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]

[list]
[*] Steam Deck verified support!
[*] Improved font size and clarity for certain menus for easier readability on smaller screens.
[*] Improved gamepad detection for better handling of menu prompts that would reference keyboard/mouse.
[*] Removed opening CSF splash screen announcement.
[*] Updated game to the latest Game Maker engine code for better performance. Note that with this change we had to remove Windowed mode, as it is no longer supported by the engine we use. To keep using Windowed mode you'll need to roll back to the previous update (v1.02.03).
[*] (MAC only) Fixed an issue that was causing the game to not show Steam alerts when playing the game. 
[/list]

notes.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious! 3?! Update! Lots of fixes to gamepad controls & more!
notes.content:
Howdy howdy y'all! So as we're looking to future proof CSD 3 for the years to come something we've wanted to do for a while is redo a lot of the gamepad control code, specifically for co-op. There were moments when menus could overlap each other and such, and those problems were much more pronounced when using an xinput controller such as a PS4 pad. 

So we've gone in and replaced a lot of the code to better support two gamepads at a time on PC, and fixed the broken xinput gamepad support since our last patch (apologies for that!). Full details are below- and hey, if you haven't wishlisted our next game, Cook Serve Forever, perhaps you could check it out! It's coming very soon and wishlists GREATLY help us!! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928090/Cook_Serve_Forever/

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]

[list]
[*]Overhauled gamepad support, specifically for two player co-op, to better prevent rare issues with menu overlaps and bugs when using xinput and non-xinput pads. 
[*]Fixed xinput gamepad support (such as PS4 gamepads) for single player and co-op.
[/list]
We plan on releasing a patch in the future that updates the links in the Socials menu as well as adding a "do not show again" toggle for the opening splash box. Thanks so much y'all for all of the support!!

notes.title: CSD 3 New Patch Released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We just released a new CSD 3 build for both PC and Mac, woo! Here's all the changes:

[b]UPDATE: If you are having issues with the Mac build after updating (it will not start and throws a Steam error code) please uninstall and then reinstall the game and that should fix it. 

If you update the Mac version, but do not see your save files in the game, they are not deleted! You'll need to copy them over to a new folder like so: 

-navigate to ~/Library/Application Support/com.yoyogames.macyoyorunner and copy the .ini files you see there (XS_CSD3_LocalSave.ini).
-if it's not there, try looking in ~/Library/Application Support/net.vertigogaming.csdthree
-copy these files to ~/Library/Application Support/net.vertigogaming.cookservedelicious3

We apologize for the issue![/b]

[b]All Versions[/b]

[list]
[*]Improved performance by rebuilding the game using the latest Game Maker 2.2 edition, which is why the patch download is so large. 
[*]Improved performance in the opening menu screen as well as the first tutorial with changes to the texture loading system.
[*]Replaced opening text splash with a new Cook Serve Forever splash.
[*]Fixed and improved some visual menu elements to better integrate gamepad and PC/mouse controls.
[/list]

[list]
[*]The game now runs on a new build for Mac that properly integrates all Steam features into the game (up until now we had a separate beta branch to use if players wanted to use certain Steam features like Achievements).

[i]As always, you can roll back to the previous version in the Beta Branch should you need to (right click CSD 3 on Steam, properties, then beta branches and select v1.01)[/i]

In case you didn't know, Cook Serve Forever was announced recently! If you love cookin' and servin' then you're gonna love our all new take on this series. Check it out and wishlist/follow today, every wishlist and follow helps TREMENDOUSLY!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928090/Cook_Serve_Forever/

[b][url=https://t.co/S73SZMhUj8]Be sure to follow us on our social platforms for more game info![/url][/b]

notes.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious series on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/c54149163d4e79f8bde63f8c4811e74169050923.png[/img]

Happy Steam Deck launch week everyone! I have to say, after a few weeks with my Steam Deck dev kit it's been a wonderful way to close out my evenings with some light gamin' with some of my favorite Steam games like Vampire Survivors and Super Auto Pets. But of course getting a Deck early helped us ensure our games, and most importantly, future games, will be fully Deck compatible! 

So what does this mean exactly? [b]Going forward, all of our Steam releases will have 16:10 support, increased save checkpointing (in case you need to jump out of a game for any reason), better text compatibility so that the UI is clear, clean and easy to read on the Deck's screen, and further optimizations! [/b]

Here is a list of our currently released games, and the best ways to play them:

[list]
[*]Cook, Serve, Delicious!- runs great, however the text is a little on the small side and therefore cannot be verified. We will take steps going forward that text is in a much larger and cleaner font. 
[*]Cook, Serve, Delicious! 3?!- runs great, but due to some keyboard command text badges is not verified just yet. We're working with YoYo Games right now to get an updated build by the summer that will remove these icons and text. 
[*]Cook, Serve, Delicious! 2!!- [b]This does not currently run without opting into Proton.[/b] This is due to a legacy Linux bug that prevents gamepad input. Again we're working with YoYo Games to release an updated Linux build sometime soon, but until then, simply go to the game's Properties in the Steam Deck UI, and force Proton compatibility by selecting the most recent stable release of Proton. This forces the game to run the Windows version, which works great. 
[*]ChefSquad- due to the nature of this game requiring Twitch, the game is not playable on the Deck.
[*]Legacy Titles- games like The Oil Blue, ShellBlast, etc. do not have gamepad support and rely on certain keyboard letters and mouse to navigate. So while a majority of them run, you'll need to remap a lot of the controls to make it fully compatible. 
[/list]

I'm so looking forward to seeing our next big game on Deck, fully supported on day one, and let me tell yah, it's gonna look gorgeous on this thing holy cow. [url=https://twitter.com/vgincgames]Be sure to follow us on our new secret Twitter account we haven't used or announced yet (don't tell anyone!!)[/url] for our new game announcement, coming soon!!

notes.title: Balance Update v0.99 Now Available!
notes.content:
Here it is, the update before we launch v1.0 next week! I've been listening to feedback since the game was content complete this summer and made some adjustments to the balance of the game.

The biggest change is the significant increase in bad orders you can get to get a bronze medal- you can now get up to 14 bad orders, instead of 7. You can also get up to 7 bad orders for silver instead of 4. This is mainly to help progression in the early stages, and of course gold medals still require flawless runs.

I've also boosted the two weaker truck upgrades a bit, and nerfed a particularly deadly food truck attack, as well as adding some bug fixes and improvements. This update will go live for consoles either on launch day or shortly thereafter on October 14th on PS4/Xbox/Switch!

Thanks everyone for all the support, and we'll see you next week for the big 1.0 launch! (v1.0 will contain minor bug fixes). 


= PATCH v0.99 NOTES =

= BALANCE CHANGES =

-Silver Medals require <8 average/bad (instead of <5)
-Bronze Medals require <15 bad (instead of <8)
-The Max Wieners sniper attack that reduces freshness expiration by 80% has been decreased to 40%
-Special System Analyzer: Lv.1 increased to 7sec (from 5), Lv.2 increased to 14sec (from 10), Lv.3 to 21sec (from 15). 
-Heat Lamps: Lv.1 increased to 20% (from 15%), Lv.2 to 40% (from 30%), Lv.3 to 60% (from 45%).


= IMPROVEMENTS AND FIXES =

-Two new trinkets added.
-Improved performance for PC/consoles.
-Fixed issue with Discord Rich Presence food statuses.
-Final art added for all "outro" cutscenes.
-Overhauled a large portion of the audio to reduce the memory footprint.
-Redid a lot of texture groups to help reduce memory footprint.
-Fixed a few mislabeled items for foods.
-Fixed rare issue with controller not responding during the Tutorial phase.

notes.title: The Grand Finale! Iron Cook Speedway (v0.95) is Now Available!
notes.content:
It's hard to believe that the journey is finally over- the Iron Cook Speedway update is now available with 30 levels in this brand new arena built specifically for speed, combat and deliciousness! 

[previewyoutube=kFkkgU29QKU;full][/previewyoutube]

The Iron Cook Speedway is an arena where contestants will race around the track, preparing orders for the judges before pulling into the Judges Tents. Along the way players will race in the combat tunnel, where food truck attacks are common and can happen multiple times in a single race! And with the Iron Cook rules prohibiting protective armor, you'll feel every hit come your way. 

The game's mechanics have been overhauled specifically for this event- I wanted to create a fast and unique gameplay style that hasn't been done in the game up to this point, which meant changing the way the game's orders come in and limiting the amount of foods per stop. That, in addition to all of the game's new sound effects and music for this event (and the in-game commentary by [url=https://twitter.com/NorthernlionLP]@NorthernLionLP[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/katelovelymomo]@katelovelymomo[/url] ) makes this one of the biggest endings to a game I've ever done. I hope y'all enjoy!

We have some smaller updates planned for the game's 1.0 release coming soon, but I just wanted to say thank you to all the fans and those who have supported us through our first Early Access release. Without y'all none of this would have been possible, and I am eternally grateful for all of your reviews, feedback and encouragement. 

Enjoy the finale, and we'll see you later this summer for the 1.0/console release!!


= PATCH v0.95f NOTES =

= NEW ADDITIONS =

*Iron Cook Speedway roars into the game with 30 new levels!
*All new commentary by @NorthernlionLP and @katelovelymomo!
*Over 20 additional trinkets!
*Enhanced Rich Presence support for Discord!
*Enhanced subtitle support across all cutscenes!


= BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS =

* The game now displays a message telling you what kind of attack occurred during food truck battles.
* Adjusted hacked visuals for better performance in streams and to help those with sensitive visual issues.
* Fixed some mislabeled serve buttons for a number of foods.
* Changed "Crazy Customers" text to "Angry Customers"
* Credits updated.
* Minor bugs addressed.

notes.title: Davidson County Update (v0.90) is Now Available!

notes.title: Drydock Harbor Update (v0.85) is Now Available!
notes.content:
Given that this would be the last territory update before our final major territory, I wanted to go a bit nuts and make a very experimental area, Drydock Harbor! It's a very small territory, with no new food trucks and limited filters, but I wanted to see what people thought of the unique days. 

The last territory update next month will go back to more traditional levels and features, but I wanted one last try to go crazy.

Also in this update are 24 new trinkets! Not only that, I've overhauled the sprite cache code so that you can now enjoy much smoother performance in-game! You can toggle this new loading system on and off, see the notes below (default is the new loading system). And we also finished up the food descriptions and added more achievements! Whew!

Enjoy the surprise update and cya next month for the finale!!! And as always, thank you so much for all the great reviews!


= UPDATE v0.85 NOTES =
= NEW ADDITIONS =

* DRYDOCK HARBOR added with 23 new experimental levels! 
* 24 new trinkets added, including four unlockable story based trinkets!
* 5 new achievements added!
* A new loading system has been added to better improve performance in-game. This caches your current menu during the load times, so that the game doesn't "hitch" when loading up a new food, but may increase level load times by a few seconds depending on your computer's performance. If you'd like to go back to the old way of loading used in previous CSD 3 versions (and in CSD 2), go to the Options menu, then Gameplay, and toggle Fast Load to ON. 
* Added a more descriptive line from Cleaver with the Max Wieners food truck attack.
* The following descriptions have been added: 
	-Tonkatsu
	-Food Truck Fries
	-Food Truck Beans
	-Food Truck Rice
	-Haemul Pajeon
	-Sinigang
	-Bibingka
	-Green Papaya Salad
	-Huauzontles
	-Jambalaya


= BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS =

* Fixed an issue with turning off certain upgrades that affected gameplay.
* Fixed issue with the No More Burgers trinket unlocking without earning a gold medal in the required day.
* Fixed bug where the scroll bar was not responding properly with the mouse in the Customize Truck menu.
* Fixed a few food description texts and punctuation.

notes.title: Metro Central Update (v0.80) is Now Available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/4a13cda65c23040e6614a1e6b5547dcf5fdd1ea1.png[/img]

Metro Central may lack charm, history, interesting sights, or anything noteworthy at all, but it more than makes up for it with their incredible Porcelain Toilets of the World museum and multiple grants to completely overhaul their sewer systems to allow for the latest tech in bathroom technology. 

Enjoy this update and we'll be back later this month with yet another update, including more trinkets! Thank y'all so much for all the reviews and support!!

* The Max Wieners food truck is on the loose! Watch for their super attack that severely damages all holding stations, decreasing freshness times by 80%!
* Two new trinkets added. These are just for the territory- we have another big trinket update coming soon!

notes.title: Metro Central Update Preview!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/63b635878c8c309daa6f32f58e9704360d4595d0.png[/img]

Welcome y'all to another update of your favorite post-apocalyptic food truck simulator! 

Metro Central is a large city with nothing really extraordinary at all. The plain hum-drum life is a nice break from the chaos of the world, despite the dark clouds looming overhead. 

That's not to say it's an easy challenge, oh no. Not only are there difficult levels ahead, but this area introduces a new food truck that can unleash a super attack! Max Wieners is on the scene with a sniper rifle that targets your temperature regulator. What does that do exactly? Well, it prevents your holding stations from getting too hot- and once its destroyed, your holding station food's freshness levels will decrease 90% faster than they normally would for the entire day! 

It is an insane attack that will destroy most players, since holding station foods will only last seconds. Good luck!

In addition to the 35+ levels there will be achievements and two extra trinkets, and the next update will feature a much larger trinket update! With the extra time I've had between this update and Newer Orleans I've also fixed a number of bugs that have needed to be addressed for a while, such as the Halo-Halo impossible recipe, the Creme Brulee torch bug that would "freeze" the brulee, decreased Well Done cooking times for meats by 50%, and more! 

Thanks y'all and look for the update early next week!

notes.title: Newer Orleans Update Preview!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/0f02807994798f998df20a4ae755cca578d9c304.png[/img]

This is by far not only the biggest update we've done for CSD 3 up to this point, but maybe the biggest update I've ever done in my whole career makin' games! How crazy is that? Let's dig into all the new goodies that you'll be getting next week!


[b]Welcome to Newer Orleans[/b]

The newest territory, Newer Orleans, is a wasteland in dire need of hope. Perhaps you can shine a light with your delicious food, Chef. Just watch out for the new Esteban's food truck- their new nasty hack attack can blind you to important UI elements, and makes prepping food even harder than usual. 

While the general guidelines for this area recommend a full Level 20 or above hazmat suit for outside use, you'll find most citizens just want to continue living and dressing as they did before. Is it a desperate yearning for life before the bombs, or ignorance, or carelessness that they don't all suit up? All I know is that guy wants a King Cake, and he's gonna get one, by golly. 

Enjoy over 30 levels with some of the hardest stops yet! Good luck Chef!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/f45ca297ad298fce2eeead7d83875e125b097953.png[/img]

[b]Steam Trading Cards & Achievements[/b]

Along with new challenging achievements we will also be releasing Steam trading cards! Collect all eight and earn delicious Gelato badges, emoticons and backgrounds. 


[b]Additional Dialogue from Whisk and Cleaver[/b]

All new end-day dialogue lines from [url=https://twitter.com/negaoryx]@negaoryx[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/HavanaRama]@havanarama[/url] have been added to the game! You can get a taste of it [url=https://twitter.com/chubigans/status/1247565939035582464?s=20]here[/url]. These were all improv'd by Havana and negaoryx and it was a lot of fun to record at the end of a very long VO session, and I'm so happy we're getting them into the game. They will pop up sporadically during the course of the game and will not be included as a "repeat" line, so they'll be a bit more rare. 


[b]Customize your Food Truck[/b]

Finally, the biggest update yet- the ability to customize your food truck! We have 40 trinkets available for this update, with dozens more to come in future updates. You'll be able to place statues and posters all over your truck, some earned, some you can buy, and a few that are challenges you must complete. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/3436ea7e739d4fd41c2b6fa80ba4cde089ae7837.png[/img]

In CSD 2 the editor was, to put it mildly, not the best in terms of user interaction. We wanted to make sure we got it right this time, and I think you'll find it to be a much better overall experience. That said we're definitely looking for feedback on any improvements that you might like in the editor, so be sure to check it out!


[b]...And More![/b]

There's still plenty more to the update, including new food descriptions, some balancing changes, and, well, more! I can't wait for y'all to dig in next week. 

Thanks once again for all the positive support y'all gave when we announced the delay of this update from March, and I hope you feel that the wait was worth it! And thank you for all the positive reviews- we're so close to 500 reviews, a huge milestone, all thanks to y'all! 

Thanks again, stay safe out there, and cya soon with the update!

notes.title: Update v0.75 Coming Early April
notes.content:
Hey y'all! As you've seen so far we've been doing well in sticking to our original Early Access roadmap. While the schedule I initially revealed was a bit of a tight one, I was confident that I'd be able to hit all the targets, barring any kind of catastrophe. 

Well, I uh don't think I need to tell you that something just like that happened. 

Unfortunately this means I have to push back our next update to early April instead of the end of this month. It's been crazy trying to reorganize our schedules and refocus on making games, but I'm finally in a good place to where I can start makin' levels and improvements again. 

While this will also push back our original May estimate of finishing the game back to June, this will also give me a chance to work on other components of the game. The original tight schedule didn't allow for me to really dig into the meat of the game to make engine improvements, and with this delay I'm going to do just that! This includes:

[list]
[*]More great voice work by [url=https://twitter.com/negaoryx]negaoryx[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/HavanaRama]Havana Mahoney[/url]! There are a number of great improv lines that I can't wait to add to the game.
[*]Ability to remap the right stick for auto-serve so that the gamepad functions more like CSD 2.
[*]The ability to customize your truck to be much larger in scope than planned. Originally I just wanted around a dozen or two dozen trinkets and only have the ability to turn them on or off. Now there will be trinket updates once a month with a much more comprehensive editor that allows you to fine tune how you want your trinkets to be displayed! 
[*]Better subtitle support for cutscenes.
[*]And lots more!
[/list]

You can expect v0.75 to include a brand new territory and the Trinkets editor as well as a few of the above improvements in early April!

Thanks everyone and I deeply apologize for the delay. I hope all of you are safe and doing well in these crazy times, and I'll be back next week with a preview of all the fun goodies we have in store. Take care,

-David

notes.title: Grandview County Update Preview!
notes.content:
One of the best things about Early Access for me as a developer is being able to watch the journey of players as they tackle new challenges. notes.title: Update Preview: Love County Brings 39 New Levels for Valentine's Day!
notes.content:
Welcome to Love County! Here in Marietta, Oklahoma things have taken a turn for the worse, and the entire area has been uprooted by the large Texas Border Wall. Now the entire city is under police and military control, which has lead to many food trucks shying away from the area...and a volatile customer base!

The routes in this city are incredibly short, meaning you'll be more focused on Special Orders than ever before. Upgrading your food truck to carry over as much food to the next stop as possible is absolutely key here. Good luck Chef!

Along with these 39 new levels comes new achievements and new features, additional story sequences and improvements! I'm also introducing two new gameplay modifiers that will further change the dynamics of the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/f506946d38b79bd80c0a094aea4a291f8914d584.png[/img]

[b]IMPATIENT CUSTOMERS:[/b] These customers don't have time to waste, and tend to leave much faster than normal customers. They walk in with the "yellow" patience attribute, which means the order will leave the screen a little faster, so make sure your Holding Stations are full of food!

[b]CRAZY CUSTOMERS:[/b] The effects of war have finally gotten to these customers, and every single one will be extremely impatient as they start with the "red" patience attribute. These levels are very nearly impossible without the right upgrades and are a massive challenge. Good luck with these, you're gonna need it!

Note that neither of these attributes affect Special Orders, just Holding Station orders.

Expect more fun challenges with every new Territory update, and cya this Friday! (update is currently scheduled to hit around 11am CST, be sure to follow [url=https://twitter.com/chubigans]@chubigans[/url] for the latest details and [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/cookservedelicious]join our Discord[/url] for the latest news!)

notes.title: v0.55 Live! Adds Achievements, Major Gameplay Balances & More!
notes.content:
I'm super excited to give you all the details on the brand new v0.55 patch, the first of many content updates for the game in Early Access! 

For this update I wanted to focus on a lot of fan requests, balancing, and major areas that needed attention. Here's some of the biggest additions to this patch: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/3b3f8d908a99e68499aad6603af1b11186c76a43.png[/img]

[b]New Steam Achievements[/b]

Eighteen new Steam Achievements have been added to the game! Most of these are retroactive, meaning as soon as you load the game and head into the Territory Select menu, they should all pop. Included with this initial set are some custom challenges that I wanted to make that are not retroactive as you must get a perfect day using new point values described in the achievement. Many of these are extremely tough, so good luck! You can expect new achievements with each new Territory patch update from now on.

Here's the full list: https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1000030/achievements


[b]Major Gameplay Balancing[/b]

One issue I've had with the game is the way Prep Stations are handled. Late in beta development I had the option to turn them off added as many players didn't like the challenge. But the notion of buying a Prep Station and then turning it off seemed wrong to me as well. There had to be a way to make Prep Stations more attractive to use, but I couldn't quite figure it out until Roni on the Steam Forums had an idea: using them as point-added modifiers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/82bd5351be50e5576a0cfd20c964745bff7fb19e.png[/img]

That means that for every Prep Station you have turned on in the Upgrades section, you will have one less point required in that specific day! The more Prep Stations you have on, the less points you'll need, but the harder the game will get. 

In case you think the game could get too easy, a reminder: all the content in the game is not even half of what's going to be available, and by using these modifiers I can really push the difficulty in the late game stages. 30 and 40 points, anyone? Muhahaha! I'm eager to hear your feedback in the forums or [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/cookservedelicious]on our Discord[/url]! 

[b]As always, I cannot stress enough how important reviews can be for us, so if you enjoy the content please leave a small review if you can![/b] Here is the full list of improvements:

[b]= PATCH v0.55d NOTES = 

= NEW FEATURES =[/b]

* You can now use Prep Stations as a way of decreasing points needed for a day! Every Prep Station upgrade is now worth one point for your menu. For example, if you have three extra Prep Stations upgraded and turned on, your point requirements for Today's Menu is decreased by 3. 
* Eighteen achievements added to the game! More achievements will be added with every new territory update!
* You can now toggle Advanced Stats in the Food Catalog and Today's Menu! This will show you which foods have Auto-Serve capabilities and how many servings it has, which also counts serving upgrades.
* Cloud Saves can be used via the Cloud submenu in the Save Slot section. This is now officially implemented (it was in previous patches of the game)
* PS/HS can now be toggled in the new Setup menu of Today's Menu, instead of having to go to the Upgrade Menu.
* Infinite Patience is now on for Practice Mode. 
* You can now sort by Purchased Rank.
* Aside from first starting up the game menu music no longer loops and instead shuffles through tracks once they end.
* The columns in the in-game Today's Menu are now colored orange for what's needed. They will turn white/gray when servings are no longer needed.


[b]= IMPROVEMENTS AND BUG FIXES =[/b]

* :Bibimbap: reclassified as a level 5 food (from a level 4)
* :Hamburgers: reclassified as a level 4 food (from a level 3)
* VoidBurger recipe added to Hamburgers.
* You can now bind the left and right arrow keys to the Page Turn button in the Options>Keyboard menu.
* Points are now displayed under Begin Day to help with achievement goals.
* Foods no longer show up in the Practice Mode if they're on Today's Menu.
* You can now skip the Medal Awarded splash screen and the Level Up music stinger as well, which should also solve any audio-related issues with the game getting "stuck" on these parts.
* Food truck attacks no longer occur in Chill Mode.
* Fixed an issue that would show the wrong objective tooltip in Today's Menu.
* You can now see costs of future upgrades that are still locked in the Upgrades menu.
* Aroma Fan upgrade has been boosted, decreasing the Perfect Combo cap by 10 for each upgrade, down to 40 instead of 50.
* Cleaver was too happy when delivering the "We lost a holding station!" line, she now looks angrier.
* Lane lights now pulse during a stop, indicating they will change once the stop is over.
* Fixed some misspellings.
* Removed CSD 2 legacy code that caused a crash with certain food truck attacks in certain circumstances.
* Corrected a few pie recipes to better reflect real-life recipes (Key Lime Pie and Rhubarb Pie).
* Sisig and Sencillo Tacos ingredient flow changed to prevent hovering ingredients. 
* Changed a few UI elements in practice mode
* Fixed a rare mouse issue in the main menu.
